blocks.text: **Present Perfect** (hozirgi tugallangan zamon) — o'tmishda bo'lgan harakat, lekin gap **hozir** haqida: o'sha harakatning natijasi hozir ko'rinib turibdi. I**'ve lost** my key — Kalitimni yo'qotib qo'ydim (hozir kalitim yo'q, uyga kira olmayapman). O'zbek tilida bunday alohida zamon yo'q: biz «yo'qotdim», «yo'qotib qo'ydim» yoki «yo'qotganman» deymiz. Ingliz tili esa o'tmishni ikki xil ko'radi: **Past Simple** — o'tmishdagi voqeaning o'zi (qachon bo'lgani muhim), **Present Perfect** — o'sha voqeaning **hozirgi natijasi** (hozir ahvol qanday). Nomida «present» borligi ham shundan: yordamchi fe'l **have / has** — hozirgi zamon shakli.

Qisqa shakl **'s** bu yerda **has** ning qisqarishi: she**'s gone** = she **has** gone. Lekin she**'s going** (Present Continuous) va she**'s tired** da **'s** = **is**. Qanday farqlash mumkin: 's dan keyin V3 kelsa (gone, finished, seen) — bu **has**; `-ing` yoki sifat kelsa — **is**.

Present Perfect da **have / has** dan keyin fe'lning uchinchi shakli — **V3** (past participle) keladi. To'g'ri fe'llarda V3 Past Simple shakli bilan bir xil: work — worked — **worked**, stop — stopped — **stopped** (imlo — 11-dars). Noto'g'ri fe'llarda V3 ba'zan V2 bilan bir xil (buy — bought — **bought**), ba'zan esa butunlay boshqa (go — went — **gone**, see — saw — **seen**). Shuning uchun noto'g'ri fe'llarni uchala shakli bilan birga yodlash kerak.

Present Perfect ni tanlash uchun o'zingizdan so'rang: bu harakat **hozirgi holatga** ta'sir qilyaptimi? Agar gapning maqsadi — hozirgi natija (narsa yo'q, bor, singan, tayyor, o'zgargan) bo'lsa, **have / has + V3**. Bunda harakat qachon bo'lgani aytilmaydi — u muhim emas, muhimi natija.

Yangilik xabar qilganda ham ko'pincha Present Perfect ishlatiladi: Guess what? We**'ve won**! — Bilasizmi? Yutdik! Bunday xabarlar ko'pincha **Guess what?** («Bilasizmi?»), **Have you heard?** («Eshitdingizmi?»), **Good news!** kabi so'zlar bilan boshlanadi. Keyin tafsilotlar (qachon, qayerda, qanday) Past Simple bilan aytiladi — bu haqda 20-darsda.

items.text: Guess what? We**'ve won** the match!
The price of milk **has gone** up.

blocks.text: Inkor — **haven't / hasn't** + V3: I **haven't finished**. Savol — **Have / Has** + ega + V3: **Has** she **called**? Qisqa javobda faqat have / has qoladi: Yes, I **have**. / No, she **hasn't**. Tasdiq qisqa javobda qisqa shakl ishlatilmaydi: «Yes, I've» emas, **Yes, I have**.

O'zbekchada Present Perfect ma'nosi bir necha yo'l bilan beriladi: «**-di**» (Kalitimni yo'qotdim), natijani ta'kidlovchi «**-ib qo'ydi / -ib qoldi**» (yo'qotib qo'ydim, buzilib qoldi), «**-ibdi**» (Qarang, kafe ochishibdi! — endi ko'rib bildim) va «**-gan**» (U Londonga ketgan — hozir shu yerda yo'q). Lekin teskarisi to'g'ri emas: o'zbekcha «-di» har doim Present Perfect bo'lavermaydi. «**Kecha** kalitimni yo'qotdim» — vaqt aytilgan, inglizchada Past Simple: I **lost** my key yesterday (20-dars).

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I have went.» → I have **gone**. (V2 emas, V3); «She have finished.» → She **has** finished.; «Have you finish?» → Have you **finished**?; «I have seen him yesterday.» → I **saw** him yesterday. (aniq o'tgan vaqt — Past Simple); «Yes, I've.» → Yes, I **have**.; «He's go to work.» → He**'s gone** to work.
Present Perfect — «**Hozir** ahvol qanday?» degan savolga javob. Gapingiz hozirgi natijani bildirsa (yo'q, bor, singan, tayyor, o'zgargan) va vaqt aytilmagan bo'lsa — **have / has + V3**.

Amerika ingliz tilida bunday holatlarda ko'pincha Past Simple ham ishlatiladi (I lost my keys). British English da Present Perfect tabiiyroq. Keyingi darslar: just / already / yet — 16, ever / never — 17, How long ...? — 18, for / since — 19, Present Perfect va Past Simple farqi — 20. Fe'llarning uch shakli — 24-dars.

rows: I**'ve lost** my keys. / She**'s gone** out.

examples.title: **I've** / **we've** / **they've** + V3
examples.description: I / you / we / they bilan — **have** + V3; so'zlashuvda qisqa shakl: I've, you've, we've, they've. Harakat bo'lib o'tgan, natijasi — hozir.

sentences.text: **I've lost** my keys, so I'm waiting for my wife.
sentences.translation: Kalitlarimni **yo'qotib qo'ydim**, shuning uchun xotinimni kutyapman.

sentences.text: **We've bought** a new sofa for the living room.
Look, **they've opened** a new café on our street!
My parents **have moved** to a bigger flat.
**You've made** a mistake in your address.
The students **have finished** their exams, and now they're on holiday.
Oh no, **I've forgotten** my phone at home!
Aziz and Madina **have invited** us to their wedding.
sentences.translation: Aziz bilan Madina bizni to'ylariga **taklif qilishdi**.

sentences.text: **We've painted** the kitchen yellow, and it looks much brighter now.
sentences.translation: Oshxonani sariqqa **bo'yadik**, hozir ancha yorug' ko'rinyapti.

sentences.text: Hurry up! The guests **have arrived**, and dinner is ready.

examples.title: **He's** / **she's** / **it's** + V3 (= **has**)
examples.description: he / she / it va birlikdagi ot bilan — **has** + V3. Qisqa shakl **'s**: she's broken = she **has** broken (is emas).

sentences.text: **She's broken** her glasses again.
Tom **has cut** his hair very short.
**It's stopped** raining — let's go for a walk.
My brother **has found** a good job in Tashkent.
The bus **has gone** — the next one is in twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: Avtobus **ketib qoldi** — keyingisi yigirma daqiqadan keyin.

sentences.text: **He's eaten** all the biscuits! There aren't any left.
sentences.translation: U hamma pechenyeni **yeb qo'yibdi**! Birontasi ham qolmabdi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **has changed** a lot — she looks very different now.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza ancha **o'zgaribdi** — hozir butunlay boshqacha ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: Our teacher **has given** us a lot of homework for the weekend.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz dam olish kunlari uchun ko'p **uy vazifasi berdi**.

sentences.text: The price of petrol **has risen** again.
Emma **has written** a lovely letter to her grandmother in Oxford.

examples.title: Irregular V3: **gone**, **done**, **taken**, **eaten**
examples.description: Ko'p noto'g'ri fe'llarda V3 V2 dan farq qiladi: go — went — **gone**, do — did — **done**, take — took — **taken**, eat — ate — **eaten**, write — wrote — **written**.

sentences.text: **I've done** all my homework, Mum!
Somebody **has taken** my umbrella.
Bekzod **has gone** to the bank, so he isn't in the office.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bankka **ketgan**, shuning uchun ofisda yo'q.

sentences.text: The children **have eaten** all the ice cream.
Sarah **has written** three books about Central Asia.
sentences.translation: Sara Markaziy Osiyo haqida uchta **kitob yozgan**.

sentences.text: Oh dear, **I've broken** your favourite cup.
Lots of snow **has fallen** in the mountains.
My little sister **has drawn** a picture of our family.
We **have spoken** to the manager about the problem.
Madina **has grown** a lot this year.

examples.title: Result now: **has broken** → it doesn't work
examples.description: Natija gapning o'zida: The lift has broken down, so we're taking the stairs. Present Perfect — «hozir ahvol qanday?» savoliga javob.

sentences.text: **I've lost** my glasses, so I'm wearing my old ones.
sentences.translation: Ko'zoynagimni **yo'qotib qo'ydim**, shuning uchun eskisini taqib yuribman.

sentences.text: The lift **has broken** down, so we're taking the stairs.
sentences.translation: Lift **buzilib qoldi**, shuning uchun zinadan chiqyapmiz.

sentences.text: Aziz **has hurt** his back, and he's lying in bed.
The shop **has closed**, so there's no bread for dinner.
sentences.translation: Do'kon **yopilib qolibdi**, shuning uchun kechki ovqatga non yo'q.

sentences.text: Someone **has left** the window open, and the room is freezing.
sentences.translation: Kimdir derazani **ochiq qoldiribdi**, xona muzdek bo'lib ketdi.

sentences.text: Emma **has dyed** her hair red — she looks great!
sentences.translation: Emma sochini qizilga **bo'yatibdi** — juda chiroyli ko'rinyapti!

sentences.text: My phone battery **has died**, so I'm using my friend's phone.
sentences.translation: Telefonimning **quvvati tugadi**, shuning uchun do'stimning telefonidan foydalanyapman.

sentences.text: Look! The river **has frozen**, and children are skating on it.
sentences.translation: Qarang! Daryo **muzlab qolibdi**, bolalar uning ustida konkida uchishyapti.

sentences.text: We **have sold** our old car, so now we take the bus to work.
sentences.translation: Eski mashinamizni **sotdik**, shuning uchun hozir ishga avtobusda boramiz.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has had** an accident, and his car is at the garage.

examples.title: Giving news: Guess what? Madina **has passed**!
examples.description: Yangilik aytganda — Present Perfect: Guess what? / Have you heard? / Good news! Tafsilotlar (qachon, qanday) keyin Past Simple bilan aytiladi (20-dars).

sentences.text: Guess what? Madina **has passed** her driving test!
Good news! James and Sarah **have got** engaged.
Our neighbours **have had** a baby girl.
A new metro line **has opened** in Tashkent.
Oh no, the price of bread **has gone** up again!
Tom **has won** first prize in the school competition!
Listen, **I've found** a new job in Manchester!
Have you heard? Aziz **has bought** a house in the country.
Dilnoza **has started** a new course, and she's really enjoying it.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza yangi kursga **qatnay boshladi**, unga juda yoqyapti.

sentences.text: Some bad news, I'm afraid: Grandad **has fallen** and **broken** his arm.
sentences.translation: Afsuski, yomon xabar bor: bobom **yiqilib**, qo'lini **sindirib olibdi**.

examples.title: Negative: **haven't** / **hasn't** + V3
examples.description: Inkor: **haven't / hasn't** + V3 — kutilgan natija hozircha yo'q. O'zbekchada ko'pincha «-gani yo'q» yoki «-ma-»: tugatganim yo'q, kelishmadi.

sentences.text: **I haven't finished** my report, so I'm staying late tonight.
sentences.translation: Hisobotimni **tugatganim yo'q**, shuning uchun bugun ishda kech qolyapman.

sentences.text: Tom **hasn't called** me, and I'm getting worried.
sentences.translation: Tom menga **qo'ng'iroq qilgani yo'q**, xavotir ola boshladim.

sentences.text: We **haven't decided** where to go on holiday.
The rain **hasn't stopped**, so the match is off.
Madina **hasn't eaten** anything today, and she feels weak.
sentences.translation: Madina bugun hech narsa **yemadi**, o'zini holsiz his qilyapti.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **haven't read** your message. What did it say?
Our guests **haven't arrived**, but the food is ready.
The price **hasn't changed**: it's still five pounds.
My son **hasn't tidied** his room, and it's a mess!
Bekzod **has bought** a ticket, but he **hasn't packed** his suitcase.

examples.title: **Have** you ...? **Has** she ...? — short answers
examples.description: Savol: **Have / Has** + ega + V3? Qisqa javob: Yes, I **have**. / No, he **hasn't**. («Yes, I've» deyilmaydi.)

sentences.text: **Have** you **seen** my phone? — Yes, it's on the table.
**Has** Aziz **fixed** the car? — No, he **hasn't**.
**Have** the children **had** lunch? — Yes, they **have**.
**Has** the post **come**? — Yes, it **has**. There's a letter for you.
Emma, **have** you **packed** your suitcase? — Not completely.
Excuse me, **has** the train to Oxford **left**? — I'm afraid it **has**.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, Oksfordga boradigan poyezd **jo'nab ketdimi**? — Afsuski, **jo'nab ketdi**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **washed** your hands? — Yes, I **have**, Mum!
Why is Dilnoza so happy? **Has** she **passed** her exam?
Sarah, where **have** you **put** the scissors? I need them.
sentences.translation: Sara, qaychini **qayerga qo'yding**? Menga kerak edi.

sentences.text: What **has happened** to your car? — Bekzod **has crashed** it into a wall!
sentences.translation: Mashinangizga **nima bo'ldi**? — Bekzod uni devorga **urib olibdi**!

examples.title: Dialogue: Have you moved into your new flat?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: Present Perfect darak, inkor, savol va qisqa javoblar jonli suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Hi, Madina! **Have** you **moved** into your new flat?
— Yes, we **have**! We**'ve brought** everything from the old place.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **o'tdik**! Eski joydan hamma narsani **olib keldik**.

sentences.text: — Great! **Have** you **unpacked** all the boxes?
— No, we **haven't**. There are boxes everywhere!
— And what about the kitchen? **Has** Aziz **put** up the shelves?
— He **has**, but one of them **has fallen** off the wall!
— Oh no! **Has** it **broken** anything?
— Yes, it**'s broken** two of my favourite plates.
— What a shame! **Have** you **met** your new neighbours?
— Yes, they**'ve invited** us for tea on Sunday. They seem really nice.
sentences.translation: — Ha, yakshanba kuni bizni **choyga taklif qilishdi**. Juda yoqimli odamlarga o'xshaydi.
